value.rationale: Minimum distinct redundant markers is the exact natural resource measured in systematic permutation codes. The first two nontrivial complete-message lengths n=3,4 attain the universal nontrivial lower bound 2, unlike the asymptotic four-marker sufficiency guarantee. A finite but sharp resource boundary and explicit codebooks are useful as short-block benchmarks without asserting asymptotic improvement.
